एक मोटा हाथी — बच्चों की कविता (हिंदी राइम) गोलू और दोस्तों के साथ! Hindi rhymes for kids: One Elephant Went Out to Play, sung in Hindi and English.
Ek mota hathi poem | hindi rhymes | nursery rhymes for kids | counting 1 2 3 | एक दो तीन गिनती.

🐘 एक मोटा हाथी, झूम के चला, मकड़ी के जाले पे झूला झूला! इतना मज़ा आया, इतना मज़ा — दूजे हाथी को बुलाया: आ जा!
🎵 Two elephants went out to play, upon a spider's web one day! They had such enormous fun, they called for another to come!
1️⃣2️⃣3️⃣ Count with Golu, Pari & Chintu: एक, दो, तीन — One, two, three! BOING! 🕸️ And Mithu gets a brand-new hat 🦜
गोलू की कविता #1 · Golu's Rhymes #1 — a traditional rhyme with our own new tune and animation.
